As Agnico Eagle Mines LTD (AEM) Share Value Rose, Shareholder Essex Investment Management Co LLC Lowered by $3.07 Million Its Position Posted by mmahotstuff 22 pm
Essex Investment Management Co Llc decreased its stake in Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd (AEM) by 32.24% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Essex Investment Management Co Llc sold 90,315 shares as the company’s stock rose 18.68% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 189,849 shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $6.49M, down from 280,164 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Essex Investment Management Co Llc who had been investing in Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.29 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.37% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $40.02. About 1.38 million shares traded. Agnico Eagle Mines Limited (NYSE:AEM) has declined 7.00% since December 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 7.00% the S&P500.
Essex Investment Management Co Llc, which manages about $740.27 million and $850.92 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 13,723 shares to 61,171 shares, valued at $13.81 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing.
Analysts await Agnico Eagle Mines Limited (NYSE:AEM) to report earnings on February, 13. They expect $0.05 EPS, down 76.19 % or $0.16 from last year’s $0.21 per share. AEM’s profit will be $11.60M for 200.10 P/E if the $0.05 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.01 actual EPS reported by Agnico Eagle Mines Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 400.00 % EPS growth.
